const OriginalAudioContext = window.AudioContext;
window.AudioContext = function (...args) { const ctx = new OriginalAudioContext(...args);
document.addEventListener('pointerdown', () => { if (ctx.state === 'suspended') { ctx.resume().catch(console.error); } }, { once: true });
return ctx; };
window.AudioContext.prototype = OriginalAudioContext.prototype;
async function extract7zURL(dataURL) { const archive = !dataURL.startsWith("data:") ? base91Decode(dataURL) : Uint8Array.from(atob(dataURL.split(";base64,")[1]), c => c.charCodeAt(0));
const files = await zip7z.decode(archive)
const blobs = {};
for (let file of files){ const lower = file.name.toLowerCase(); let mime = ""; if (lower.endsWith(".js") || lower.endsWith(".mjs")) mime = "text/javascript"; else if (lower.endsWith(".css")) mime = "text/css"; else if (lower.endsWith(".html") || lower.endsWith(".htm")) mime = "text/html"; else if (lower.endsWith(".webp")) mime = "image/webp"; else if (lower.endsWith(".png")) mime = "image/png"; else if (lower.endsWith(".jpg") || lower.endsWith(".jpeg")) mime = "image/jpeg"; else if (lower.endsWith(".svg")) mime = "image/svg+xml"; else if (lower.endsWith(".json")) mime = "application/json"; else if (lower.endsWith(".wasm")) mime = "application/wasm"; blobs[file.name] = URL.createObjectURL(new Blob([file.data], { type: mime }));
}
return blobs; }
const BASE91_TABLE = 'ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZabcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123456789!#$%&()*+,./:;<=>?@[]^_`{|}~"'; const BASE91_DECODE = {};
for (let i = 0; i < 91; i++) { BASE91_DECODE[BASE91_TABLE[i]] = i; }
function base91Decode(str) { let v = -1, b = 0, n = 0; const out = [];
for (let i = 0; i < str.length; i++) { const c = BASE91_DECODE[str[i]]; if (c === undefined) continue;
if (v < 0) { v = c; } else { v += c * 91; n |= v << b; b += (v & 8191) > 88 ? 13 : 14;
while (b >= 8) { out.push(n & 255); n >>= 8; b -= 8; }
v = -1; } }
if (v >= 0) out.push((n | (v << b)) & 255);
return new Uint8Array(out); } const c = false;

let trimmed = original.split("/").pop(); let trimmed2 = original.split('?')[0];
if (trimmed.includes("?")) trimmed = trimmed.split("?")[0]
const match = trimmed2.match(/(api|assets|fonts|img|js|snd)\/.*/); if (match) trimmed2 = match[0];
